overview.title: Audit Overview
overview.description: Current audit workload across selection, active cases, evidence, controls, review, reconciliation and closure.

riskCases.title: Risk Cases
riskCases.description: Prioritized cases created from substantive A–E risk signals across the officer's global Audit scope.
riskCases.note: Risk Level is a review priority, not a conclusion. Findings require a verified signal linked to evidence. TIN is masked by default.

control.title: Control & Data Quality
control.description: Separate F0–F5 consistency and filing-control queue. These items do not increase substantive Risk Level.
control.note: Data-quality and control flags stay on a separate path from Risk Cases. F5 dependency remains unresolved in the source framework.

secondReview.title: Second Review
secondReview.description: Supervisory review of completed verification trails before closure.
secondReview.note: The current design brief assigns second review to the supervising Range Officer. Review must name the signal and evidence; generic approval text is not sufficient. Permitted outcomes are Sign off or Request rework.

rules.title: Rules & Governance
rules.description: Versioned rule change requests, mandatory dry-runs, endorsement, approval and controlled rollout.
rules.note: Rules are never edited in place. New or changed rules require a dry-run, then follow DCT authoring → Range Officer endorsement → Commissioner approval under the current design assumption. Shadow mode records results without routing cases.

reconciliation.title: Reconciliation
reconciliation.description: Daily confirmation that each high-risk return has a corresponding case within the relevant supervisory scope.
reconciliation.note: Reconciliation is surfaced to Range Officers for their Circles and to the Commissioner for the Zone. A mismatch is an oversight issue; it does not silently change Risk Level.

trail.title: Audit Trail
trail.description: Append-only event history for assessment, human decisions and sensitive-data access.
trail.note: Nothing is overwritten or deleted. Corrections are new events. Return Version, Classification Version and Rule/Config Version travel with the assessment so the original decision can be reconstructed.

allTaxpayers.title: All Taxpayers
allTaxpayers.description: Global audit population across all Circles. Search any taxpayer or return, then use Circle and audit dimensions to narrow the population.
allTaxpayers.note: This Audit workspace is configured for cross-Circle access. Circle remains an operational context and filter, not an access boundary.

signalFlow.title: Decision logic
signalFlow.dataHold: Incomplete or invalid required inputs → Data Quality. Do not run this signal.
signalFlow.noTrigger: Condition not met → no signal trigger.
signalFlow.triggerReview: Condition met → review signal under its approved rule/configuration.
signalFlow.evidencePending: Evidence incomplete → remain pending, not a finding.
signalFlow.evidenceRefuted: Evidence contradicts the concern → record refuted/resolved with reason.
signalFlow.supportedScreening: Evidence supports screening signal; human review still required.
signalFlow.humanReview: Deduplicate by underlying fact; evaluate independent evidence and record the officer decision. A signal alone is not a tax finding.
signalFlow.genericWarning: Confirm the source records before recording any decision.

c1.eligibility: Confirm applicable IT-10B, complete DT1 wealth/expense data and valid numeric fields. NULL is not zero.
c1.dataHold: Stop: incomplete/invalid data; correct the source first.
c1.notApplicable: If the statement is lawfully not required, mark not applicable; do not infer zero.
c1.independence: IT-10B line 10 must be independently calculated from assets 8(a–k) + 9; line 7 comes from the separate funds-flow path.
c1.shadow: Block execution / shadow-only until line-10 independence is proven.
c1.calculate: Compute gross wealth (line 7), total assets (line 10) and Gap = 10 − 7. Validate the alternative funds-flow identity.
c1.formulaHold: Arithmetic/source mismatch → separate control review; no reliable C1 outcome.
c1.materiality: Apply the approved comparison limit for the correct year. If no approved limit is available, leave the result undecided.
c1.noTrigger: Compare the verified gap with the approved limit. If it does not exceed the limit, this signal does not trigger.
c1.evaluateStrength: If the verified gap exceeds the approved limit, review its direction, amount and underlying evidence.
c1.strength: A larger confirmed difference may need priority review, but only the approved rule can assign a level.
c1.formulaSource: Sources = 1(a) income + 1(b) exempt income + 1(c) gifts/other receipts; line 3 = Sources + line 2 prior net wealth.
c1.formulaGross: Uses = 4(a) IT-10BB + 4(b) other expenses/loss; line 5 = line 3 − Uses; line 7 = line 5 + line 6 personal liabilities.
c1.formulaAssets: Line 10 = 8(a–k) asset components + line 9; must be independent of line 7.
c1.formulaIdentity: Cross-check: Gap = ΔNet Wealth − (Sources − Uses). Verify period, treatment of loans/tax and double counting.
c1.approvalWarning: Check the filed figures and approved rule before recording a conclusion.
